study: AEOeye robots.txt check for Amazon and Meta crawlers (Oct 2026)
sample: Same 391 domains as the AEOeye AI Crawler Access Study
method: GET https://<domain>/robots.txt (www retried if unreachable), parsed with AEOeye's audit parser; 'blocks' = the agent's effective rules disallow '/'. 4xx or HTML robots.txt = no restrictions; 5xx/unreachable excluded.
